agency.name: Botswana Medicines Regulatory Authority (BoMRA)
agency.desc: Established under Medicines and Related Substances Act (Act No. 8 of 2013) as Botswana's independent statutory body regulating medicines, controlled substances, and pharmaceutical products.

divisions.name: Enforcement Div.
divisions.desc: Border control, seizure of counterfeit/illegal products & prosecution.

divisions.name: Pharmacovigilance Div.
divisions.desc: Drug safety monitoring, clinical trials oversight & product registration.

statute.title: Medicines and Related Substances Act (Cap. 63:04) & Penal Code (Cap. 08:01)

items.label: Penal Code — Drug Trafficking:
items.text: 5–25 years imprisonment for commercial-scale trafficking and large-scale distribution.

items.label: Penal Code — Simple Possession:
items.text: Fines and short-term imprisonment for minor possession.

items.label: MRSA 2013 — Unauthorized Distribution:
items.text: Prohibits unauthorized manufacture, sale, or distribution of controlled substances. BoMRA authorized to inspect, seize, and revoke licenses.

items.label: Dangerous Drugs Act — Consumption:
items.text: Mandates clinical treatment protocols alongside penal restrictions for illicit substance consumption.

zones.title: Uppers (Crystal Meth, Cocaine, Khat)
zones.keywords: crystal meth mathawa dombo tik glass ice cocaine crack khat mairungi energy drinks uppers

items.heading: Crystal Meth (Mathawa / Tik / Dombo)
items.law: MRSA 2013 Schedule 1A — Controlled Drug & Narcotic. Penalties under Penal Code Cap. 08:01 for unauthorized possession, manufacture, or distribution.

punishments.label: Possession:
punishments.text: Fines and short-term imprisonment. Mandatory drug testing in criminal proceedings.

items.heading: Cocaine & Crack Cocaine (Coke / Charlie / Mabwe)
items.law: MRSA 2013 Schedule 1A — Controlled Drug & Narcotic. Penal Code Cap. 08:01 for trafficking and possession.

punishments.label: Possession:
punishments.text: Fines and imprisonment. Quantity, packaging, and monetary value determine sentencing.

items.heading: Khat / Mairungi (Miraa)
items.law: MRSA 2013 — Regulated as controlled substance. Unauthorized importation or distribution prohibited.

zones.title: Downers (Heroin, Benzos, Alcohol, Cough Syrups)
zones.keywords: heroin nyaope whoonga pinch smack benzos mandrax alcohol kachasu khadi chibuku cough syrup bronco lean

items.heading: Heroin & Street-Cut Opiates (Nyaope / Whoonga / Smack)
items.law: MRSA 2013 Schedule 1A — Controlled Drug & Narcotic. High abuse potential with physical and psychological dependence.

punishments.label: Possession:
punishments.text: Fines and imprisonment. Mandatory clinical treatment protocols may apply.

items.heading: Benzodiazepines & Sedatives (Benzos / Mandrax / Majozi)
items.law: MRSA 2013 Schedule 1B — Psychotropic Substances & Controlled Sedatives. Valid written prescription required with quantitative limits per fill.

punishments.label: Unauthorized Possession:
punishments.text: Fines and imprisonment. Strict record-keeping requirements for dispensing.

items.heading: Alcohol & Illicit Spirits (Kachasu / Khadi / Chibuku)
items.law: Liquor Act — Licensing Requirements & Operating Hours. Underage restrictions: sale to persons under 18 years strictly prohibited.
items.note: Traditional brews (Khadi, Kachasu) may fall outside formal licensing but remain subject to public health regulations.

punishments.label: Underage Sale:
punishments.text: Prohibition of sale, supply, or serving to any person under 18 years. Compliance duties on venue operators.

punishments.label: Operating Hours Violation:
punishments.text: Fines and license revocation for trading outside permitted hours.

items.heading: Prescription Cough Syrups (Bronco / Lean / Siropo)
items.law: MRSA 2013 Schedule 1C — Targeted Therapeutics with Abuse Potential. Codeine-containing combinations require valid medical prescription.

punishments.label: Unauthorized Sale:
punishments.text: Pharmacy licensing violations and prosecution under MRSA 2013.

zones.title: Cannabis, Vaping & Tobacco
zones.keywords: cannabis motokwane dagga mbanje ganja weed vaping vape juul tobacco motsoko bute snuff shisha

items.heading: Cannabis (Motokwane / Dagga / Mbanje)
items.law: MRSA 2013 Schedule 1A — Controlled Drug. Unauthorized cultivation, possession, or distribution prohibited.

punishments.label: Cultivation:
punishments.text: Fines and imprisonment. quantity-based sentencing for commercial cultivation.

punishments.label: Possession:
punishments.text: Fines and short-term imprisonment. Mandatory drug testing in criminal proceedings.

items.heading: Vaping & E-Cigarettes (Vape / Juul)
items.law: MRSA 2013 — Regulation of electronic nicotine delivery systems under medicines legislation. BoMRA authorization required for importation and sale.
items.note: E-cigarette regulations evolving. Check latest BoMRA directives.

punishments.label: Unauthorized Importation:
punishments.text: Seizure and prosecution under MRSA 2013 border procedures.

items.heading: Tobacco & Snuff (Motsoko / Bute / Shisha)
items.law: MRSA 2013 — Tobacco products subject to labeling standards and advertising restrictions. Public Health Act regulates smoking in public places.

punishments.label: Public Smoking:
punishments.text: Fines under Public Health Act for smoking in prohibited areas.

zones.title: Gambling, Forex & Digital Addiction
zones.keywords: gambling betting aviator mabhetis botheki forex crypto bitcoin scheme digital addiction social media gaming

items.heading: Gambling & Sports Betting (Mabhetis / Botheki / Aviator)
items.law: Gambling Act — Licensing and regulation of gambling operations. Underage gambling strictly prohibited.

punishments.label: Underage Gambling:
punishments.text: Prohibition of participation by persons under 18 years. Venue operators liable.

punishments.label: Unlicensed Operations:
punishments.text: Fines and closure of unlicensed gambling operations.

items.heading: Forex & Crypto Trading Schemes
items.law: Bank of Botswana Act — Regulation of financial services and foreign exchange. Pyramid schemes prohibited under anti-fraud legislation.
items.note: Cryptocurrency regulation evolving. Check latest Bank of Botswana directives.

punishments.label: Pyramid Schemes:
punishments.text: Prosecution under anti-fraud legislation. Fines and imprisonment.

items.heading: Online Gaming & Microtransactions
items.law: Electronic Communications Act — General regulation of digital services. Loot box mechanics may fall under gambling regulations depending on jurisdiction.

punishments.label: Predatory Mechanics:
punishments.text: Consumer protection regulations may apply. Check latest directives.
